failure_analysis: All 9784 outputs are code continuations, not pass/fail predictions. Root cause: repo-level code + 3 few-shot examples exceed 8192 token limit. Script truncates with ids[:max_seq_length] cutting off generation prompt and query. 72.96% accuracy is pure majority class base rate.
conclusion: Naive few-shot fails at repo-level due to context length. Supports paper narrative that fine-tuning is necessary for repo-level complexity.
